The Guard’s mission isn’t about luxury accommodations—it’s about restoring order amid violent riots targeting ICE agents.

Newsom’s sudden concern for troop welfare rings hollow after he refused to protect federal personnel, leaving DHS no choice but to act. Lawful enforcement isn’t negotiable, and federalizing the Guard was the only way to halt the chaos Newsom enabled.

Priorities matter: protect agents first, then critique logistics.
